method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Dow Jones Industrial Average shrugs off a hawkish new Fed chair to set a record
Equities.summary: There is confident, and then there is Friday. The Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) ground out a fresh all-time high, up around a quarter of a percent, on a day that gave it nothing to celebrate.
Equities.reason: Market-level price action: US large-caps hit fresh highs despite a hawkish Fed narrative, signalling continued risk-on sentiment and resilience of equities to policy headwinds.

Equities.title: Wall Street rises, Dow hits record high as Middle East hopes lift sentiment
Equities.reason: Broad-market positive: easing geopolitical risk (Iran talks) lifted sentiment and supported a multi-market rally, reinforcing a risk-on regime across US equities.

Equities.title: SpaceX launches redesigned Starship in successful pre-IPO test
Equities.summary: Elon Musk’s company demonstrates the technology at the heart of the biggest initial public offering in history
Equities.reason: IPO/tech-cycle positive: successful pre-IPO test bolsters confidence in a large upcoming SpaceX IPO and contributes to the broader mega-IPO narrative that is feeding market optimism.

Equities.title: S&P 500 Bulls Power Longest Weekly Gain Since 2023: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Strong broad-market momentum: multi-week winning streak indicates sustained bullish positioning and reinforces the dominant risk-on regime in US equities.

Equities.title: Workday jumps 5% as it bumps up margin forecast on AI strength
Equities.summary: Workday's CEO says the company is seeing success in artificial intelligence.
Equities.reason: Earnings-driven upside: company-level beat and AI-driven margin guidance underscore the 'earnings/AI-led' market narrative supporting sector rotation and bullish flows.

Equities.title: Qualcomm's stock pop shows investors are 'waking up' to boom in AI devices
Equities.summary: Qualcomm is on a big run, powered by investor bullishness that the company will be at the center of a boom in AI devices.
Equities.reason: Sector leadership expanding: chip/AI device optimism is broadening market leadership beyond a single name, supporting tech/semiconductor outperformance.

Equities.title: Chip stocks are hitting fresh records, but Nvidia isn't the driver
Equities.reason: Broader semiconductor rally: record highs across chip stocks indicate diffusion of AI-related gains beyond the largest cap, reinforcing market breadth within tech.

Equities.title: Kevin Warsh sworn in as Federal Reserve chair by President Trump
Equities.reason: Monetary policy risk: new Fed chair with a hawkish tilt increases the risk of a higher-for-longer rates regime, which is a material negative for multiple equity valuations and risk assets.

Equities.title: BofA’s Hartnett Warns Mega-IPOs Risk Bubble Like Roaring ’20s
Equities.reason: Structural caution: a prominent strategist warning of IPO-driven excess increases tail-risk perception for the mega-IPO pipeline and could temper speculative flows.

Equities.title: China Launches Major Crackdown on Illegal Securities Trading
Equities.reason: EM/China downside: regulatory enforcement and cross-border flow controls raise risk for Chinese equities and offshore fintech listings, weighing on regional risk appetite.

Equities.title: Nasdaq Bitcoin Index Options Granted Approval by SEC
Equities.reason: Crypto-to-risk-asset spillover: greater institutional access to bitcoin derivatives can modestly support risk appetite and cross-asset liquidity, benefiting risk-on positioning.

Rates.title: Surge in 'risk-free' treasury yields sends bond investors in search of better opportunities
Rates.reason: Headline indicates a broad rise in US Treasury yields (bond selloff). High relevance to global rates and market liquidity — negative for bond prices and signals higher-for-longer policy/pricing.

Rates.title: Bond Traders Bet Fed Under Warsh Will Hike Rates This Year
Rates.reason: Market pricing shift toward rate hikes under the new Fed chair pushes Treasury yields higher. Strong market-impact signal on Fed path and term premium — negative for bond holders.

Rates.title: Kevin Warsh takes oath of office as chairman and a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, and the Federal Open Market Committee unanimously selects Warsh as its chairman
Rates.summary: Kevin Warsh takes oath of office as chairman and a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, and the Federal Open Market Committee unanimously selects Warsh as its chairman
Rates.reason: Official confirmation of a new Fed chair shifts the policy regime narrative. Markets view Warsh as more likely to tolerate or pursue tighter policy — net upward pressure on yields.

Rates.title: Fed's Waller: Should remove easing bias from statement
Rates.summary: Federal Reserve (Fed) Governor Christopher Waller said on Friday that he does not expect to support a change in the policy rate in the near term, adding that the outcome will depend heavily on the length of the Iran conflict, per Reuters.
Rates.reason: A senior Fed official arguing to remove easing bias is a modest hawkish signal that supports higher yields; direct Fed-speaker relevance but not alone decisive.

Rates.title: Fed's Warsh says he will lead reform at the Fed
Rates.summary: Freshly-minted Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh delivered his first public speech as head of the Fed on Friday, delivering his key talking points after being sworn in.
Rates.reason: Chair's early remarks on reform and stance raise uncertainty about policy framework; modestly hawkish market interpretation but lower direct immediacy on rates.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, April 28-29, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, April 28-29, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes provide read-through on policy deliberations; in the current context they reinforce a less-dovish/hawkish tilt, supporting higher rate expectations and yields.

Rates.title: Yield Curves May Steepen Further in Key Southeast Asian Markets
Rates.reason: Regional steepening implies rising longer-dated yields in ASEAN markets — meaningful for local fixed-income and carry trades, negative for bond prices regionally.

Rates.title: ASEAN-6 inflation: Pipeline pressures and rate risks – DBS
Rates.summary: DBS Group Research economists Radhika Rao and Chua Han Teng highlight that ASEAN-6 economies are experiencing asymmetric inflation outcomes despite a common energy shock. Indonesia and Malaysia show relatively contained inflation, while Thailand, Vietnam and P
Rates.reason: Inflation pipeline pressures across ASEAN raise the risk of regional rate hikes — modest upward pressure on local yields and repricing risk for EM duration.

Rates.title: Japanese Yen: Tokyo CPI and intervention data watched – Deutsche Bank
Rates.summary: Deutsche Bank analysts expect Japan’s Tokyo Consumer Price Index (CPI) to show a slight acceleration, with core CPI ex fresh food seen at 1.6% YoY and core-core at 2.0%. Industrial production is forecast to rise 0.2% MoM.
Rates.reason: Signs of accelerating Tokyo CPI increase pressure on JGB yields and raise intervention/BOJ reaction risk — modestly negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: London Traders Are Stuck With an Ultra-Long Bond Bet Gone Bad
Rates.reason: Illustrates market losses from rising long-end yields and positioning stress — amplifies risk sentiment around duration and could worsen liquidity for long bonds.

Rates.title: Danaher Raises $3 Billion in Record Private-Placement Bond Sale
Rates.reason: Large corporate issuance increases supply in the credit market and can add modest upward pressure on corporate yields; limited systemic impact.

Rates.title: Consumer sentiment hits fresh record low in May as Iran war fuels inflation worries
Rates.summary: Consumer sentiment has tumbled to a fresh record low in May as fears of higher prices grow due to the U.S.-Iran war and elevated oil prices.
Rates.reason: Geopolitical-driven inflation worries (oil risk premium) increase the odds of sustained inflation and tighter Fed pricing — supportive of higher yields.

FX.title: US Dollar: Supported into holiday as risk stays contained – Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank’s global FX strategy team highlights the Dollar is ending the week on the offensive, with modest gains against most G10 currencies as markets focus on US–Iran developments and the swearing-in of Fed Chair Kevin Warsh.
FX.reason: Sell-side note flags broad USD strength into a holiday driven by geopolitics and Fed leadership — a cross-market theme that pressures non-USD FX and is market-relevant.

FX.title: Euro slips as Iran deal doubts lift demand for the US Dollar
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) retreats by 0.14% during the North American session on Friday amid growing speculation that the US and Iran may reach a deal to end the conflict. The Greenback is recovering some ground, underpinned by Oil prices trimming some of its earlier los
FX.reason: Geopolitical news lifting USD demand and weighing on EUR — clear USD-centric flow that reinforces dollar strength vs major currencies.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar weakens as US-Iran uncertainty and hawkish Fed bets support Greenback
FX.summary: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) remains on the defensive against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday as traders look past stronger Canadian Retail Sales figures and keep their attention on developments surrounding US-Iran negotiations.
FX.reason: Highlights USD strength driven by geopolitical risk and Fed repricing, overcoming domestic positive data — reinforces dollar-centric narrative and CAD underperformance.

FX.title: Japanese Yen weakens as stronger US Dollar and elevated energy prices weigh on sentiment
FX.summary: USD/JPY holds firm on Friday, remaining confined within this week’s trading range as traders refrain from placing aggressive bullish bets near the 160.00 handle following suspected intervention by Japanese authorities in late April.
FX.reason: Notes yen pressure from a stronger USD and energy-driven sentiment; fits the broader USD-up, JPY-down theme and is relevant for G10 FX positioning.

FX.title: US Dollar: PCE slowdown and hawkish Fedspeak – TD Securities
FX.summary: TD Securities economists expect April core and headline Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index to moderate to 0.26% and 0.43% month-on-month, translating to 3.3% and 3.8% year-on-year. They also see softer nominal and real personal spending.
FX.reason: Mixed macro signal: softer PCE would ease rate risks (USD-negative) but hawkish Fed commentary keeps upside risk for the dollar — modest net USD-supportive tilt.

FX.title: Dollar Stalls as Hope for US-Iran Peace Boosts Risk Sentiment
FX.reason: Contrary, market-piece indicating risk-on optimism from peace hopes that would weaken the dollar and support non-USD currencies — important counter-signal to geopolitical-driven USD demand.

FX.title: Indian Rupee: RBI step up as nears record low against US Dollar – DBS
FX.summary: DBS Group Research economist Radhika Rao notes that the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has revived monetary operations as the Rupee approached a record low near 97 per US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: Central-bank FX operations to defend the rupee signal local currency pressure from USD strength — a tangible example of the wider dollar-driven stress in EM FX.

FX.title: Turkey’s FX Sales Reach $6 Billion After Opposition Ruling
FX.reason: Material FX interventions by Turkish authorities point to local currency stress and active FX defense — reinforces EM currency pressure narrative amid political shock and USD demand.

FX.title: Asia's currencies are flashing oil shock alarm
FX.reason: Analysis suggesting an oil-driven shock to Asian FX adds a commodity-driven downside risk for regional currencies versus the USD — supports broader dollar/EM stress narrative.

FX.title: Eurozone: Weak PMIs and higher inflation forecasts – Rabobank
FX.summary: Rabobank’s Senior Macro Strategist Teeuwe Mevissen reports that Eurozone growth indicators have deteriorated, with French and German PMIs signaling contraction and the German IFO near a five-year low.
FX.reason: Weaker activity in the Eurozone suggests downside risk for the euro vs the dollar; contributes to the prevailing USD-support narrative across Europe.

Commodities.title: US Oil Rig Count Up by Most in Four Years Amid Drilling Recovery
Commodities.reason: A large increase in US rig counts signals accelerating US production that should ease near-term oil supply tightness and weigh on oil prices; material for energy commodity balances.

Commodities.title: Iran war leaves U.S. gas prices at highest levels in nearly four years ahead of Memorial Day
Commodities.summary: Global oil inventories are declining fast with just four to six weeks until gasoline, diesel and jet fuel prices shoot higher, analysts said.
Commodities.reason: War-related supply risk and fast-declining inventories are a strong bullish driver for oil and refined fuels; high relevance for energy markets and seasonal demand ahead of holiday driving.

Commodities.summary: We forecast U.S. industrial natural gas consumption will climb to record highs through 2027 in our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook. Industrial consumption averaged a record 23.6 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2025, 1% more than the record 23.4 Bcf/d re

Commodities.title: Trafigura Withdraws Huge Volumes of Copper From LME Warehouses
Commodities.reason: Large physical withdrawals from LME stocks indicate tightness or strong physical demand, a direct bullish signal for copper prices and market structure.

Commodities.title: Bellwether Industrial Metal Copper Is Trading Like an AI Stock
Commodities.reason: Links between copper demand and AI-related industrial investment point to structural demand upside for copper, supporting a bullish copper narrative beyond cyclical flows.

Commodities.title: Copper: Sluggish supply growth offsets risk aversion – Commerzbank
Commodities.summary: Commerzbank reports Copper has fallen about 5% from mid‑May highs, mainly on higher risk aversion from rising Oil prices. Yet China’s April Copper output dipped 4.5% month-on-month and mining news from Chile and Indonesia point to weaker supply growth.
Commodities.reason: Evidence of weak supply growth (China output dip; mining constraints) helps offset demand-driven or risk-off price moves—net supportive for copper but with some near-term volatility.

Commodities.summary: Gold price edges lower during the day as the Greenback recovers some ground amid doubts that the US and Iran could reach a deal to end the conflict, and traders are pricing in a Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike by the end of the year. At the time of writing, XA
Commodities.reason: Hawkish Fed commentary that boosts the USD raises opportunity cost for holding gold and is a meaningful near-term headwind for the metal.

Commodities.title: Gold holds within weekly range as US-Iran talks remain in focus
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) consolidates on Friday, remaining confined within this week’s trading range as investors cautiously monitor ongoing diplomatic efforts between the United States and Iran to reach a deal to end the war in the Middle East.
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical risk from US–Iran negotiations provides a supportive floor for gold amid broad macro cross-currents (USD, rates); supportive but lower relevance than Fed/US-dollar drivers.

Commodities.title: Coal remains competitive for power generation in the central United States

Commodities.reason: Favorable economics for coal-fired generation in parts of the US points to continued demand support for thermal coal regionally; relevant to coal market fundamentals.

Crypto.title: OKX and ICE are bringing 'never-expiring' oil futures to 120 million crypto users
Crypto.reason: Cross-asset product distribution to a large crypto user base increases institutional-grade derivative availability and on‑chain/off‑chain flow between commodity and crypto markets — modestly positive for adoption and liquidity.

Crypto.title: SEC Commissioner Peirce counters views that crypto rule will foster synthetic tokens
Crypto.reason: Clarifying regulatory commentary that pushes back on risk narratives reduces uncertainty around token structure and secondary product development — small positive for market confidence and product innovation.

Crypto.reason: Idiosyncratic but market-relevant altcoin momentum — NEAR's on‑chain growth narrative and price surge reinforce altcoin rotation and development-led upside within crypto markets.

Crypto.title: XRP ETFs attract inflows amid wallet surge. bitcoin, ether funds struggle.
Crypto.reason: Material flows into XRP ETFs while BTC/ETH funds bleed signals rotation and selective ETF-driven demand — important for fund flows, product adoption and market structure (positive for tokenized/ETF channels).

Crypto.reason: Platform-level executive departure tied to revenue slowdown highlights retail-trading softness and potential headwinds to onboarding and fee-based liquidity — modestly negative for ecosystem flows.

Crypto.title: Why Minnesota is empowering local banks to fight Wall Street for crypto revenue
Crypto.reason: Local banking initiatives to capture crypto business expand institutional on‑ramps and custody relationships — supportive for broader adoption and payment/fiat rails integration.

Crypto.title: Mark Cuban says he sold most of his Bitcoin after failed hedge narrative 'disappointed' the billionaire
Crypto.reason: High‑profile investor selling feeds bearish sentiment and undermines the narrative of bitcoin as a macro hedge — modest negative for sentiment and retail perception.

Crypto.title: Satoshi’s 1.1 million bitcoin and millions more can be saved from quantum attack, says expert
Crypto.reason: Technical resilience against quantum threats reduces long‑term existential security concerns for bitcoin holdings — small positive for institutional risk calculus.
